note: Per-category JQL over DIIM summary + description (comments excluded: they mention resets/BMC generically). triage runs each query against the tickets that name the host.

queries.gddr: project = DIIM AND (summary ~ "gddr" OR summary ~ "dram" OR summary ~ "ddr" OR description ~ "gddr" OR description ~ "\"dram training\"" OR description ~ "\"memory training\"" OR description ~ "bist")
queries.pcie: project = DIIM AND (summary ~ "pcie" OR summary ~ "pci" OR summary ~ "enumerat*" OR summary ~ "\"drops off\"" OR summary ~ "chips" OR summary ~ "\"chip missing\"" OR summary ~ "detected" OR description ~ "PcieHangError" OR description ~ "0xffffffff" OR description ~ "AER" OR description ~ "lspci")
queries.tensix: project = DIIM AND (summary ~ "tensix" OR summary ~ "nondetermin*" OR summary ~ "non-deterministic" OR summary ~ "pcc" OR summary ~ "ND" OR summary ~ "aiclk" OR summary ~ "noc" OR summary ~ "L1" OR description ~ "tensix" OR description ~ "aiclk" OR description ~ "\"physical cores\"" OR description ~ "nondetermin*" OR description ~ "\"PCC mismatch\"")
queries.bmc: project = DIIM AND (summary ~ "bmc" OR summary ~ "ipmi" OR summary ~ "redfish" OR description ~ "bmc" OR description ~ "ipmi" OR description ~ "ipmitool" OR description ~ "bmc_bots" OR description ~ "\"bmc bot\"")
queries.reset: project = DIIM AND (summary ~ "reset*" OR summary ~ "POST_RESET" OR summary ~ "\"power cycle\"" OR summary ~ "reboot*" OR summary ~ "recycle" OR summary ~ "POST" OR description ~ "POST_RESET" OR description ~ "glx_reset" OR description ~ "\"tt-smi -r\"" OR description ~ "ttop-ipmi-reset" OR description ~ "cpld")
